repo_notes.content: Obsidian plugin (TypeScript, strict mode) — plugin ID pubmed-fetcher — that fetches academic article metadata from PubMed, PMC, DOI, arXiv, and Web of Science identifiers: create notes, insert citations, batch-update links.

Provider architecture: src/providers/ has one file per provider, each owns ID extraction + response translation to a shared ArticleInfo type; providers/index.ts holds the PROVIDERS registry and collectProviderIds(). Chains resolve PMC->PubMed and DOI->PubMed with CrossRef fallback.
src/api.ts exposes raw fetchers with dependency injection via RequestFunction — never call requestUrl directly in API functions (enables mocking in tests).
src/citation.ts formatCitation iterates CITATION_ORDER rendering provider + article-type icons from the central typed catalog in src/icons.ts.

Build: esbuild bundles main.ts -> main.js (CJS). Tests: Vitest + v8 coverage. ESLint flat config + eslint-plugin-obsidianmd with sentence-case acronyms/ignoreWords configured — add proper nouns to config, not eslint-disable.
See AGENTS.md for the full module graph, conventions, and testing guidelines.
